snippet.title: Grand Tour Legends Trailer (Playdate)
snippet.description:
Get Grand Tour Legends on the Playdate Catalog here: https://play.date/games/grand-tour-legends/

Hop on that bike and crank your way through the Grand Tour. Manage your stamina, time those hills and valleys on your way to the finish line. Careful not to Bonk! Crank it up! Be the next Legend!

Find out more about Grand Tour Legends: https://www.iorama.studio/gtl
Find out more about IORAMA: http://iorama.studio/
Join the IORAMA newsletter: https://www.iorama.studio/newsletter
Follow IORAMA on Instagram: http://instagram.com/iorama.studio
Follow IORAMA on Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/iorama.bsky.social
Join the IORAMA Discord: https://iorama.studio/discord

Grand Tour Legends is a crank-operated arcade racing game. Spin those pedals and battle 19 other riders across the tour. Experience the thrill of hurtling down the alpine countryside after an exhausting climb. Feel the ocean breeze as you sweep along the coastline. Work out the perfect strategy on each track, save energy to crank it when you need it!
